Container.Name: maniac-media
Container.Overview: Maniac Media – unified movie and TV automation (Sonarr + Radarr in one). Metadata, indexers, download clients, automatic import, renaming, quality profiles, users and an encrypted, migratable database.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface and API (container port stays 8000). Change only if 8193 is in use.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Appdata: database, encrypted secrets, logs, backups and plugins. Keep this path across updates.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Share containing media/ and downloads/. Use ONE share for both so paths match and hardlinks are possible. Map your download client to /data the same way. Change the host path to match your shares.

Config.Name: Master key
Config.Description: Encrypts stored credentials. Generate ONCE with: openssl rand -base64 32 – and keep a copy somewhere safe. Changing it makes stored credentials unreadable.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as (100 = users)

Config.Name: Movies folder (first run)
Config.Description: Seeds the movie root folder on first run only; change later in Settings → Media management

Config.Name: TV folder (first run)
Config.Description: Seeds the TV root folder on first run only; change later in Settings → Media management

Config.Name: Downloads folder (first run)
Config.Description: Seeds the completed-downloads watch folder on first run only (must exist); change later in Settings → Media management
